approval.confirmation_reference: The user authorized uninterrupted best-in-plan execution; the sealed anchor sidecar decision requires head-only training next, and this is its zero-update resource/readiness proof.
approval.scope: One zero-optimizer fit batch-128 forward/backward repeat plus full fit/C07 loader identity audit; 256 model-forward rows, no checkpoint, C08+, graph or M-TARE.

corrective_scope: V1 failed only because a paper-figure histogram treated anchor norm >=80 m as invalid. V1R preserves every numeric target and all scientific gates, records the true maximum, and counts values beyond the 80 m display range in an explicit overflow bin.

estimated_cost.compute: One RTX 5090 D batch-128 forward/backward and repeat; zero optimizer.

failure_policy: Any source, count, loader, loss, gradient, repeat, environment or resource drift fails closed before training; do not reduce evidence or start optimizer work.

metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.decision: PASS allows the exact three-seed training Data Card/spec; it is not learned performance and does not unlock C08.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.gradients: All 8 head gradients are finite and nonzero, all backbone gradients absent, all six losses finite, repeat outputs/losses exact.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.parameters: Three source checkpoints bind exact hashes; real seed0 model has 2635631 frozen backbone and 22278 trainable head parameters in 8 tensors.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.population: Loader identities exactly cover fit 60 parents/180 tasks/426552 rows and C07 10/30/64644; model forward is exactly two repeats of one 128-row fit batch.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.resources: Peak CUDA allocation and GPU process memory each <=16 GiB; host RSS <=4 GiB; zero optimizer/checkpoint/C07 model forward/C08+/graph/M-TARE.

purpose: Prove exact batch-128 loader, loss, frozen-backbone gradient and GPU resource contracts before the three-seed optimizer run.
retention: Retain hashes, test/resource/loss metrics, environment, logs, RUN_STATE and seal.

sampling.independent_sampling_units: 70 program-generated topology parents; three geometry realizations are paired repeated measures within each parent.
sampling.rule: Audit all 180 fit and 30 C07 shard identities/counts, then read the first deterministic 128-row fit batch twice through frozen seed0 backbone and untrained anchor head.

source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research use of project-generated Cano assets; redistribution remains subject to upstream licensing.
raw_sources: sealed P1a corrected C01--C07 sensor pose and construction-program primitive endpoints
sealed P1b C01--C07 five-frame cropped primitive axes and endpoint-neighbor labels
sealed V2 relation failure attribution establishing zero safe true attachment for all three seeds

split.development_transfer: C08 remains forbidden until a future relation model passes C07.
split.fit: All C01--C06 rows are audited without fitting a model or threshold.
split.historical_pollution_audit: Only C01--C07 populations already exposed to development are used to diagnose the failed Teacher/model contract. No transfer or test claim is made.
split.selection: C07 is reported separately; it does not tune the fixed support bands or the 0.99/0.95 decision thresholds.
split.strict_test: C08/C09/C10 and all M-TARE benchmark worlds remain unread.

teacher.coordinate_contract: World anchors are translated by current sensor_xyz_m and rotated by negative current yaw into current-sensor XYZ. Pitch/roll are absent from the frozen sensor contract.
teacher.identity_contract: Node and primitive identities are used only offline to validate construction ordering. The sidecar contains only numeric anchor targets and source sequence indices.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: This sidecar authorizes head-only relation learning only. Graph edges will remain traversal-verified and cannot be created from Teacher identity.
teacher.source: Sealed P1a base_construction endpoint composition_anchor_xyz_m, exact P1b primitive_index/primitive_mask/frame_row/source sequence order, and sealed P1a current sensor xyz/yaw.
teacher.student_forbidden_inputs: Construction node/primitive identity, world coordinates, sensor world pose, TNG, future frames, C08+ and topology labels never enter the student forward pass.
teacher.valid_mask: Only endpoint anchors belonging to P1b primitive_mask=1 slots enter regression or relation losses. Inactive slots are stored as exact zero and remain loss-masked.
